```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

Water Balance 
$$
p = E + Q - \Delta S
$$

```{r}
streamflow = function (precip, ET, dS=0) {
  
  if (class(precip)!="numeric") {stop(print("etc etc"))}
  
  Q = precip - ET + dS
  
  if (Q<0) {warning("q is negative")}
  
  return(Q)
  
}

source("week2/R/streamflow.R")

```

```{r}
df = data.frame(
  day = seq(1, 1000),
  P = rbeta(1000, 1, 100) * 100,
  E = rbeta(1000, 1, 100) * 10,
  S = rbeta(100, 1, 0.1)
)

pivot_df = pivot_longer(data = df, cols = !day, names_to = "variable", values_to = "values")
```
